_comment: Expected mapped-finding counts per IaC type, measured with the CLI (--output json). Single source of truth for tools/smoke_check.py AND .github/workflows/ci.yml — update both consumers change automatically when these numbers change. min findings are floors (mapped counts can drift up as checks/mappings are added); expected is the last measured count for exact-comparison reporting. vulnerable = must be >= min (and > 0); compliant = must be exactly 0.
